name: next-up-card
title: Next up card
description: The next thing on your day: title, time range, place, who is in it and a countdown in words, with Join or Directions and a calm all-clear.
docs: Pass `now` from the server for a stable first render; without it the card reads the clock in the browser and ticks once a minute. The countdown is plain text, not a live region, so a screen reader is not interrupted. Join needs `event.link`, Directions needs `event.place`; give `directionsHref` for your own maps link.
